positions.title: Producer / project lead
functions: Integrate team deliveries and decide milestone readiness
deliverables: Bounded project brief and milestone decisions
positions.evidence_mode: Owner requirements, technical findings and real outcome checks

positions.title: Working technical lead / software engineer
functions: Review subordinate engineering and integrate its results
positions.evidence_mode: Executable technical evidence; own production is checked by the parent with independent technical findings

positions.title: Gameplay engineer
functions: Implement bounded gameplay and interface behavior

positions.title: Game and level designer
functions: Organize playtest questions and interpret actual feedback
deliverables: Playable content and scoped design data
positions.evidence_mode: Actual play sessions and owner product review; opinions alone do not prove fun

positions.title: Working art lead / visual generalist
functions: Produce the main visual direction and key assets
Review subordinate assets for style and technical integration
deliverables: Visual target and reusable asset specifications
positions.evidence_mode: Rendered artifacts, engine constraints and human or qualified visual review; not numeric technical skill inference

positions.title: Generalist artist / animator
functions: Produce bounded environments, interface assets and animation
deliverables: Engine-ready assets and animation with source provenance
positions.evidence_mode: Actual visual assets, import checks and direct-supervisor review

positions.title: QA and build/release specialist
functions: Reproduce defects and verify accepted behavior
Prepare release checks and regression evidence
deliverables: Actionable defect reports and regression results
positions.evidence_mode: Independent actual builds and observed checks; no peer signoff authority

positions.title: Temporary music and sound specialist
functions: Produce scoped music and sound effects and validate in-game timing
deliverables: Usable audio assets and integration findings
positions.evidence_mode: Auditioned in-game output and qualified human or audio review; do not infer it from code tests

positions.title: Temporary community and release support
functions: Prepare store materials and organize authorized external feedback
deliverables: Release materials and genuine feedback inventory
positions.evidence_mode: Reviewed materials and actual responses; external publication or contact still needs authorization
